title: Bananas (per lb)

drivers.name: Halloween (event week)
drivers.evidence: 2025: +17% lift vs baseline; 2024: +1%; noise-adjusted x1.0, but 2025's lift is statistically meaningful and repeatable.

drivers.name: Store closed Monday
drivers.evidence: One day of sales lost in a 7-day week; prior closure in 2024 reduced sales by ~14% in similar product.

drivers.name: Price increase (+1.5%)
drivers.evidence: Past 1.5% price rise in 2026-09-28 led to 11% drop in sales; price sensitivity observed.

adjustment.analysis: Halloween (Sat) is a known driver with a noise-adjusted multiplier of x1.0, but past data shows a 1.17 lift in 2025. The price increase to $0.68 (+1.5%) may slightly dampen demand. Store closure on Monday removes one day of sales, reducing weekly volume. The baseline already reflects a -12.2% 13-week trend, but the target week is 3 weeks after the last data point, so no trend carryover. The classical uplift model's x1.0 is too low given the 2025 lift. Adjust upward modestly for Halloween, reduce for closure and price. Evidence is thin (one strong past lift), so shrink toward 1.0.

PRODUCT: Bananas (per lb) | category Produce | Store #12 (Austin, TX)
TARGET WEEK: 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-01 (3 weeks after the last week with sales data)

KNOWN PLAN FOR THE TARGET WEEK:
  events: Holiday: Halloween (Sat)
  shelf price: 0.68 (+1.5% vs regular price 0.67)
  planner notes: Store closed Monday for renovation

STATISTICAL BASELINE (exponential smoothing of recent sales; it ignores events, promotions and prices):
  median 438.2 | 5%-95%: 312.8 - 555.7 | 10%-90%: 346.7 - 528.9

In the evidence below, 'vs baseline' = actual units / what this same baseline predicted for that week.
It is the multiplier that would have been right, so it maps directly onto median_multiplier.
This product's ordinary weeks already swing about +/-21% around the baseline, so a past effect smaller than that, seen only a few times, is mostly noise. The
'noise-adjusted estimate' is the effect shrunk toward x1.0 for that noise and the number of sightings.
